title: vandellia tectanthera
intro: Vandellia tectanthera, commonly known as 'Indian bloodroot', is a plant species belonging to the family Erythrophleaceae, native to the tropical forests of India and Southeast Asia. The plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to treat conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin disorders, making it a sought-after ingredient in traditional medicine. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate blood circulation, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Vandellia tectanthera include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
